defs.def: all the plants, animals and things that exist in the universe that are not made by people 宇宙中的万物；自然界；大自然

ex.s: Nature treats all lives as EQUALS
ex.t: 根据以赛亚·伯林的观点，刺猬精通一件事，而狐狸通晓许多事。

ex.s: When John Todd was a child he loved to explore the woods around his house, observing how nature solved problems.
ex.t: 当约翰·托德还是个孩子的时候，他喜欢探索房子周围的树林，观察大自然如何解决问题。

ex.s: With the right combination of animals and plants, he figured, maybe he could clean up waste the way nature did.
ex.t: 他想，通过正确的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理废物。

ex.s: Nature can repair itself.
ex.t: 大自然可以自我修复。

ex.s: As cities balloon with growth, access to nature for people living in urban areas is becoming harder to find.
ex.t: 随着城市不断膨胀扩张，生活在城市地区的人们越来越难接触到大自然。

ex.s: Past research has found health and wellness benefits of nature for humans, but a new study shows that wildness in urban areas is extremely important for human well-being.
ex.t: 过去的研究发现了大自然对人类健康和幸福的益处，而一项新研究表明，城市中的自然野趣对人类的幸福极其重要。

ex.s: They surveyed several hundred park-goers, asking them to submit a written summary online of a meaningful interaction they had with nature in the park.
ex.t: 他们调查了数百名公园游客，要求他们在线提交一份书面摘要，描述他们在公园里与大自然的某种有意义互动。

ex.s: be close to nature.
ex.t: 接近大自然。

ex.s: At the side of roads, behind school playgrounds and on all kinds of unloved pieces of land across towns and cities, tiny forests barely the size of tennis courts are appearing, making a great place for both wildlife and local people who may not normally have easy access to nature.
ex.t: 在路边、学校游乐场后面以及城镇和城市之间的各种不受爱戴的土地上，几乎没有网球场规模的细小森林正在出现，这为野生动物和当地人提供了一个大好地方，他们通常无法轻易进入大自然。

ex.s: “We see it as a chance to try to break the growing disconnect between people and nature.”
ex.t: 我们把它看作一个机会，试图打破人与大自然之间日益加深的疏离。

ex.s: Nature never ceases to surprise.
ex.t: 大自然从不停止给人惊喜。

ex.s: He documented his journey as he set about treating nature as a brand to be marketed to young people.
ex.t: 他记录了自己的历程，开始把大自然当作一个面向年轻人推广的品牌来经营。

ex.s: Market Nature to Children           D.
ex.t: 向儿童推销自然 D.

ex.s: Reflections on Human Nature
ex.t: 好奇心永不满足

ex.s: My faith in human nature has never been so great as it was last weekend after our family get-together in the town of Vail.
ex.t: 我对人性的信心从未像上周末在韦尔镇家庭聚会后那样强烈。

ex.s: 38     In these places patients can go to be near nature during their recovery.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 38     在这些地方，患者可以在康复期间亲近大自然。

ex.s: Being in nature refreshes us.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 身处大自然使我们精神焕发。

ex.s: Nature: An Outdoor Classroom.
ex.t: 大自然：户外教室。

ex.s: Many of us love July because it’s the month when nature’s berries and stone fruits are in abundance.
ex.t: 我们许多人喜欢七月，因为这是大自然浆果和核果丰收的季节。

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
ex.t: 大自然似乎向那些观察和等待的人展开。下次你散步时，无论在哪里，都要领略所有的景色、声音和感觉。带着这种心态闲逛，你会为生活打开一个新的维度。

ex.s: try our best to protect nature
ex.t: 我爬啊爬。除了绿色灌木丛和这些台阶什么都没有。我必须到达山顶！

ex.s: This brief visit with Mother Nature cost me two days off from work, recovering from a bad case of sunburn and the doctor’s bill for my son’s food poisoning.
ex.t: 这次与大自然的短暂接触让我请了两天假，还因为严重的晒伤和儿子食物中毒的医药费而恢复了好一阵子。

ex.s: 40     It must be true that sooner or later, everyone finds his or her way back to nature.
ex.t: 40     每个人迟早都会回归大自然，这一定是真的。

ex.s: After years of observing human nature, I have decided that two qualities make the difference between men of great achievement and men of average performance curioscy and discontent.
ex.t: 经过多年对人性的观察，我已认定有两种品质决定了成就卓著者与表现平庸者之间的差别：好奇与不满。

ex.s: He realised that something needed to change, and, being a London media type, appointed himself "marketing director for Nature".
ex.t: 结果就是《野性事物》这部电影它记录了野性网络组织的诞生这是一个有着共同目标——让孩子们走进大自然——的组织联盟。

ex.s: One of the most wonderful migrations in nature is that of the North American monarch butterfly.
ex.t: 自然界中最奇妙的迁徙之一，是北美帝王蝶的迁徙。

ex.s: There is no doubt that the Bernina Express is a journey for travellers who want to get back to nature: the train window becomes the TV screen, and the natural world is the show.
ex.t: 毫无疑问，贝尔尼纳快车是为想要回归自然的旅行者准备的旅程：火车窗户变成了电视屏幕，自然界就是节目。

defs.def: the way that things happen in the physical world when it is not controlled by people 自然；自然方式

ex.s: Referred to as matrix planting, this approach aims for nature to do a lot more of the heavy lifting in the garden, and even some of the designing.
ex.t: 这种方法被称为“矩阵种植”，旨在让自然在花园中承担更多繁重工作，甚至部分设计。

ex.s: After studying agriculture, medicine, and fisheries in college, John went back to observing nature and asking questions.
ex.t: 在大学学了农业、医学和渔业后，约翰回去观察自然并提出问题。

ex.s: Across the 320 submissions, a pattern of categories the researchers call a “nature language” began to emerge.
ex.t: 在320份提交材料中，一种被研究人员称为“自然语言”的类别模式开始显现。

ex.s: Naming each nature experience creates a usable language, which helps people recognize and take part in the activities that are most satisfying and meaningful to them.
ex.t: 为每种自然体验命名创造出一种可用的语言，帮助人们认识并参与那些对他们来说最令人满足、最有意义的活动。

ex.s: Wild nature is hard to find in cities.
ex.t: 城市中很难找到自然野趣。

ex.s: People enjoy living close to nature.
ex.t: 人们喜欢住得离自然近一些。

ex.s: Young people are too busy to interact with nature.
ex.t: 年轻人太忙了，无暇与自然互动。

ex.s: The same nature experience takes different forms.
ex.t: 同一种自然体验可以呈现不同的形式。

ex.s: The nature language enhances work performance.
ex.t: 自然语言能提高工作表现。

ex.s: What should be done before we can interact with nature according to Kahn?
ex.t: 根据卡恩的说法，在我们能与自然互动之前应该做什么？

ex.s: “It can bring a new interest and focus into people’s lives and help to make the link between home and nature.”
ex.t: 它能给人们的生活带来新的兴趣和焦点，并帮助建立家与自然之间的联系。

ex.s: “We focus on urban areas where access to nature is often not that easy”, says Hartley.
ex.t: "我们专注于那些通常不太容易接触到自然的城区，"Hartley说。

ex.s: To get people close to nature.
ex.t: 让人们亲近自然。

ex.s: Shortly after I received his invitation, applications to join the Youth for Nature and the Youth for Planet groups were sent around through my high school.
ex.t: 不久，我收到了他的邀请，申请加入 " 青年为自然 " 和 " 青年为星球 " 团体 通过我的高中。

ex.s: I decided to commit to completing the applications, and soon I was a part of a growing global team of young people working to protect nature.
ex.t: 我决心完成申请，很快我就成为一个不断壮大的全球年轻人团队的一员，致力于保护自然。

ex.s: After all, nature does not require our patience, but our action.
ex.t: 毕竟，自然不需要我们的耐心，而是需要我们的行动。

ex.s: She decided to do something for nature.
ex.t: 她决定为自然做点什么。

ex.s: The concept of beauty today is very different from what it was in ancient Greece or the Middle Ages, and so are most of our “laws” of nature.
ex.t: 如今美的概念与古希腊或中世纪时的概念大不相同，我们大多数自然"定律"也是如此。

ex.s: Henry David Thoreau was happy to                   from social life, seeking a harmonious relationship with nature in the quietness of his life.
ex.t: 亨利·戴维·梭罗很高兴                  社交生活在他生活的宁静中寻求与自然的和谐关系。

ex.s: Timekeeping is increasingly related to nature．
ex.t: 计时越来越与自然相关．

ex.s: We should live in harmony with nature．
ex.t: 我们应该与自然和谐相处．

ex.s: are really fascinated by nature
ex.t: B．对自然真的非常着迷

ex.s: A nervous night to be sure, but sometimes the spirits of nature smile on us all!
ex.t: 确是一个紧张的夜晚，但有时自然的精灵会眷顾我们所有人！

ex.s: And for that to happen, we also need to protect nature so that we can interact with it,” said Peter Kahn, a senior author of the study.
ex.t: 而要做到这一点，我们还需要保护自然，这样我们才能与之互动，该研究的资深作者彼得·卡恩说。

ex.s: From David Waters To Kay Silverman Subject Back to nature Hi Kay, We’re having an amazing time here in South Africa.
ex.t: 发件人大卫·沃特斯 收件人凯·西尔弗曼 主题 回归自然 嗨凯，我们在南非玩得特别棒。

ex.s: Today, the Longji Rice Terraces attract thousands of visitors who come to admire this great wonder created by people and nature working together.
ex.t: 如今，龙脊梯田吸引成千上万游客前来欣赏人与自然共同创造的这一伟大奇迹。

ex.s: To work full time in travel, you have to love nature.
ex.t: 要在旅行中全职工作，你必须热爱自然。

ex.s: Walking is the best way to gain access to nature.
ex.t: 散步是接触自然的最好方式。

ex.s: The result was Project Wild Thing, a film which charts the birth of the Wild Network a group of organisations with the common goal of getting children out into nature.
ex.t: 成果是《野生动物计划》这部影片，它记录了“野生网络”的诞生——一个由多个组织组成的、以让孩子走进自然为共同目标的团体。

defs.def: the usual way that a person or an animal behaves that is part of their character 天性；本性；性格

ex.s: These adorable little hunters are just doing something that it's been in their nature since the beginning of time.
ex.t: 这些可爱的小猎手只是在做一件自远古起就刻在他们天性里的事。

ex.s: True to a gorilla’s unaggressive nature, the huge animal    69   (mean) me no real harm.
ex.t: 符合大猩猩不具攻击性的天性，这只巨兽___69___（mean）并无真正伤害我的意思。

defs.def: the basic qualities of a thing 基本特征；本质；基本性质

ex.s: We need to deal with the insecure nature of our telecom networks.
ex.t: 我们需要应对电信网络不安全的本质。

ex.s: But we want to go beyond one man and explore the nature of genius itself.
ex.t: 但我们想超越某一个人，去探索天才本身的本质。

ex.s: It's not a simple matter to determine the nature of talent.
ex.t: 要确定天赋的本质并不是一件简单的事。

ex.s: The Internet has made data abundant, all-present and far more valuable, changing the nature of data and competition.
ex.t: 互联网让数据变得丰富、无处不在且价值大增，改变了数据和竞争的性质。

ex.s: This nature of data makes the antitrust measures of the past less useful.
ex.t: 数据的这一性质使得过去的反垄断措施不太有效。

defs.def: a type or kind of sth 种类；类型
having the type of character or quality mentioned 构成形容词
